A free expense tracker that works fully offline. No account is required, and there are no purchases or subscriptions. A banner ad, served by Google AdMob, may appear at the bottom of the main screens, and an occasional full-screen ad (at most once every ten minutes) may appear when you close the Insights screen; ads never cover your financial data and no feature is locked behind an ad.

Built with official AndroidX libraries (AppCompat, Room, Material Components, WorkManager), Google Play services for the optional Drive connection, and the Google Mobile Ads SDK with Google's User Messaging Platform for the ad consent flow.

Full privacy information: Settings > Privacy, plus your ad consent choices under Settings > Ad privacy options where required. Privacy policy: https://litemobiletools.github.io/Daily-Expense-Tracker-Page/privacy.html
